app.title: Operator — trading_bot
tip.nav.research: Strategy math, evidence charts and selection rationale
tray.hidden_hint: Operator is still running in the tray. Right-click → Open / Launch web / Exit.
desk.trade.hint: Pause blocks new entries · does not flatten · positions below are simulated, not exchange
desk.trade.hint_halted: New entries paused · Resume allows entries again
desk.panels_hint: drag panel edges to resize · Window menu toggles panels
desk.votes_grip: =  drag up/down — votes height (pinned to bottom)
desk.banner.feed: Market feed is {source} (not live API) · exchange={exchange} {error}
desk.votes.empty: No votes yet. Enable strategies on Consilium or System.
chart.title: Chart
chart.hint: wheel zoom · Shift+wheel / LMB pan · Home — live edge · hover — OHLC
chart.ind.title: Chart indicators
chart.ind.intro: Price overlays (SMA, EMA, Bollinger). The lower pane (volume / oscillators) is chosen separately in the toolbar. Changes apply immediately.
chart.ind.bottom_intro: Only one lower pane is active at a time.
chart.ind.sma_help: Simple moving average over {n} bars — smooths price and shows the average trend.
chart.ind.ema_help: Exponential average over {n} bars — reacts faster to recent prices than SMA.
chart.ind.bb_help: Mean ± 2σ over 20 bars. Price at the band edge often means overbought/oversold.
chart.ind.bottom.volume_help: How much traded each bar. Spikes often line up with strong moves.
chart.ind.bottom.rsi_help: Relative Strength Index 0–100. Above ~70 overbought, below ~30 oversold.
chart.ind.bottom.macd_help: Fast vs slow EMA difference plus signal line. Crosses and histogram show momentum shifts.
chart.ind.bottom.delta_help: Close vs previous bar. Useful to see step strength without volume.
chart.no_bars: no candles yet — wait for data or pick a symbol
ticker.title: Quotes
ticker.help: Live prices. Click a row to open that symbol on the chart.
ticker.empty: No symbols yet — wait for market data or pick instruments in Book.
dom.title: Order book
book.title: Book
book.subtitle: Which instruments we trade right now
book.howto: Tick the instruments you want, then press Apply list. That sends the active book to the engine (command SET_UNIVERSE) — Desk quotes and strategies follow this list.
book.mode_help: Manual — you pick the list. Screener — engine ranks by profile floors (liquidity / vol / asset class). Hybrid — screener + your pins.
book.catalog_help: Checked = active (manual). Screener still shows catalog metrics; open positions stay pinned.
book.empty_offline: No engine connection. Start host/main.py --headless and wait for a snapshot.
book.empty_catalog: Catalog is empty. Enable a market service under System (e.g. CCXT Bitget), then come back — or add keys manually above.
con.title: Consilium
con.subtitle: Strategies vote here — see the result and choose who to listen to
con.howto: Top = final decision. Table = votes. Weights here are for the current lineup — add/remove strategies on the Strategy page.
con.empty_offline: No engine snapshot yet. Start the engine to see votes.
con.empty_no_strategies: Nobody is voting yet. Open Strategy, tick strategies into Consilium, press Apply lineup.
con.no_decision: No decision yet — waiting for the first strategy signals…
con.votes_help: BUY/SELL = buy/sell suggestion. Matches = agrees with the final call. Confidence = signal strength (not a profit guarantee).
con.weights_help: Sliders matter in Manual mode. To add or exclude strategies, use the Strategy page roster.
con.lineup_hint: Full list and Consilium include/exclude live on the Strategy page.
con.no_lineup: Consilium is empty — add strategies on the Strategy page.
con.mode.risk_parity: By risk — quieter strategies weigh more
con.mode_help: Start with Equal. Use Manual if you want to set importance yourself. The others are advanced.
con.strategies_hint: Current Consilium voters. Manage membership on the Strategy page.
con.params_help: Simple knobs: how fast it reacts, and how much size it uses in paper/phantom.
con.class_help: Instrument class: TQBR (MOEX stocks), CRYPTO, etc. Should match Book.
con.tickers_help: E.g. SBER, GAZP or BTC/USDT. Empty = use the active universe.
con.param_fast_help: Short price memory. Smaller = reacts faster (and noisier).
con.param_slow_help: Longer memory. Must be larger than fast. Too large = almost never moves.
con.param_window_help: How many recent bars define a “normal” price.
con.param_z_help: How far price must wander before a signal (z-score / σ). Higher = fewer trades.
con.qty_help: How many lots/units to buy/sell per trade (paper/phantom).
ph.title: Phantom
ph.subtitle: Sandbox: pretend trades with no live account risk
ph.howto: Top: run settings and scenarios. Middle: chart + timeline with live state. Bottom: run table (click to load a scenario) and fills.
ph.empty_offline: No engine link — phantom stays empty until connected.
ph.kpi_help: Shadow account summary: profit/loss, drawdown from peak, virtual equity.
ph.run_help: History and/or selected synthetic scenarios. Optimize explores a denser grid and can take longer.
ph.patterns_help: One scenario by default. Tick extras to compare several market regimes.
ph.state_help: State at the scrubbed bar: position, PnL, mark price, and the latest strategy decision.
ph.fields_help: Ticker e.g. SBER or BTC/USDT. Class TQBR for stocks, CRYPTO for crypto. Bars = how many candles (default 500; walk-forward needs ≥160 at train=60/test=20/folds=5). Source = where history comes from.
ph.symbol_search_help: Search by ticker or Book catalog key (active book first). Picking one fills ticker and market class for the run.
ph.mode.optimize: Optimize — dense search for this strategy
ph.mode_help: Grid = quick compare of a few settings. Optimize = search many combinations. Walk-forward = train/test folds with reproducibility.
ph.wf_help: Default bars=500, timeframe=1d. Engine auto-bumps bars if below the fold minimum (~160). variant_mode=optimize searches a dense param grid under OOS fold selection (preferred). grid = quick 3-point check. History feed for comparable eval. Seed makes runs reproducible. Report includes buy-hold / fee=0 / fixed-default baselines.
ph.wf.result: WF feed={feed} seed={seed} folds={folds} mean={mean} std={std} CI={ci} chosen={chosen} family={family}
ph.batch_help: Batch = dense walk-forward for all strategies in the combo on this ticker (optional extra tickers). Uses holdout bars from Walk-forward settings.
ph.apply_chosen_help: Write top batch digest / last WF chosen (+ research ticker) into plugin config. Ack includes live-readiness grade.
ph.risk_help: TradingView-style sizing: % equity, cash, fixed qty, risk %, ATR risk, or fractional Kelly. Strategy strength can scale size.
ph.strat_params_help: Base knobs from CONFIG_SCHEMA. Grid/optimize vary on top of these values.
ph.strat_params_empty: This strategy has no tunable parameters.
ph.reset_help: Clear resets phantom fills only. Live/paper accounts are untouched.
ph.grid_help: Each row is one settings set. Prefer higher profit with a drawdown you can live with.
ph.grid_click_help: Click a row to load that scenario’s candles, timeline, and fills.
ph.chart_help: Candles from the historical run, with the same strategy lines and buy/sell markers as on Strategy / Desk.
ph.chart_empty: Run a grid to load candles and markers here.
ph.timeline_help: The scrubber moves a yellow playhead across the full run: candles to the left are revealed, the right stays empty. Scale stays fixed.
ph.timeline_empty: Run a grid first — the time scrubber appears with candles.
ph.timeline_viz_only: Chart markers are strategy_viz hints (not shadow fills). Re-run Phantom — research now captures strategy.signal even when capture_source=ensemble.
ph.timeline_last_decision: Last decision up to this bar:
ph.fills_help: What phantom “filled” recently. Not exchange orders — a sandbox for ideas.
ph.status.need_ticker: enter a ticker — e.g. SBER or BTC/USDT
charts.title: Charts
charts.subtitle: Candles and equity for the selected symbol
charts.howto: Pick a symbol, then zoom/pan like on Desk. Pop-out opens a separate window.
sys.title: System
sys.subtitle: Market, risk, AI, storage, and extensions
sys.page_desc: Market / keys / risk / AI / storage / extensions
sys.howto: Change a setting, then Apply. Save writes it into the engine config file.
sys.market_keys_hint: Bitget / Alpaca API keys → Keys tab (stored in SQLite, not YAML).
sys.notify.help: Windows system toasts. By default only while Operator is in the tray. Events can be batched into one toast.
sys.notify.tray_hint: Hint toast on first hide to tray
sys.notify.channels_help: Windows toast (tray/balloon), system sound, and optional Telegram bot. Token is stored locally under data/ui/.
sys.notify.filters_help: Comma-separated lists. Empty include = all. Exclude always drops. Events without ticker/strategy (halt) are not blocked by include.
sys.notify.batch_help: Accumulate events and show one toast (title “Events (N)” + line list).
sys.notify.urgent_help: Types marked urgent below fire as their own toast immediately (halt / risk / recon by default).
sys.notify.test_body: If you see this, toasts are working.
sys.notify.test_fail: Could not show a toast (check Windows notifications)
sys.storage_help: Engine events go into a few durable buckets, each written to a chosen database. Routing changes without restart. Live candles stay in memory — this page is journals (signals, decisions, fills, market).
sys.storage.guide: Pipeline: signal → decision/reject → execution/risk.reject → portfolio.snapshot. Also stored: lineup, universe, ops.alert, reconciliation, AI request/response. Signals ≠ fills. Outside lineup, counterfactuals need observe/shadow.
sys.storage.routing_title: Where each kind of event is stored
sys.storage.routing_help: Pick a backend per class. Default applies when a class has no route or the event type has no known prefix.
sys.storage.default_help: Used if a class is unset; also for unmatched prefixes (phantom/ai/backtest often ride the market-stream route today).
sys.storage.class.semantic_stream.title: Market stream
sys.storage.class.semantic_stream.help: Candles and other market.* (plus often phantom / AI / backtest). High volume → DuckDB or ClickHouse; paper / low volume → SQLite.
sys.storage.class.finding.title: Signals
sys.storage.class.finding.help: Raw strategy.signal: what a strategy proposed (side, strength, reason) before consilium and fills. Not the same as a trade. Keep writing always (SQLite locally; Postgres if shared). Counterfactuals outside lineup need observe/shadow mode.
sys.storage.class.state.title: Universe / book state
sys.storage.class.state.help: universe.* (active book, reselect). Small but important for “what were we trading”. SQLite locally; Postgres when shared.
sys.storage.class.audit.title: Execution & audit
sys.storage.class.audit.help: execution.*, risk.reject, ensemble.decision/reject, portfolio.snapshot, config.lineup_changed, ops.alert, reconciliation.incident, system.halt*. Durable: SQLite; multi-host: Postgres. Keep default=sqlite until classify maps all prefixes.
sys.storage.recommend: Start: all → sqlite (and default=sqlite); never drop Signals. Market grows → semantic_stream → duckdb_local. Postgres/CH for shared server or high ingest. Canon: docs/architecture/storage.md.
sys.storage.persist_help: Off = apply for this engine run only (like GG). On = write routing/backends into trading_bot.yaml for next start.
sys.storage.backends_help: Enable a backend and set its path/URL before routing classes to it. Reload registers it without restarting the whole process.
sys.storage.backend_tip.sqlite: SQLite — local file DB. Best default for audit, state, signals. Simple, no server.
sys.storage.backend_tip.duckdb_local: DuckDB — local analytics DB. Good for market stream / candle history and later stats queries.
sys.storage.backend_tip.jsonl_local: JSONL — debug spill only, not a real source of truth. Prefer SQLite/DuckDB.
sys.storage.backend_tip.parquet_local: Parquet — cold archive of batches. Not for hot journal queries.
sys.storage.backend_tip.chdb_local: chDB — embedded ClickHouse. Heavy analytics locally; optional.
sys.storage.backend_tip.clickhouse_main: ClickHouse server — high-ingest market stream when volume is large.
sys.storage.backend_tip.cockroach: CockroachDB — distributed Postgres-wire for HA shared journals.
sys.storage.backend_tip.generic: {id} — enable and set path/URL, then point a class at it in routing.
sys.storage.hint_offline: Engine offline — connect to manage storage.
sys.market_help: Trading mode and which market feeds are on. Paper = simulated. Live needs real keys.
sys.live_warn: WARNING: {mode} sends real orders. Apply will ask for confirmation.
sys.live_confirm_body: Switch trading mode to {mode}? Real capital may be at risk. Kill switch stays one-click.
sys.live_confirm_required: Live/QUIK requires confirmation — use Apply again and confirm.
sys.market_services_help: Enable at least one source. CCXT (Binance etc.) is the usual choice for crypto.
sys.alpaca_help: Needs API keys in Window → API keys. Not required for Binance.
sys.risk_help: Safety limits. Percent fields use 0–100%. Absolute drawdown is in account currency (0 = off). Whichever limit hits first stops trading.
sys.risk.adv_help: Leave at 0 to disable. Daily loss / turnover / concentration are also %.
sys.ext_intro: Engine plugins only (not strategies). Strategies live in the Strategy window.
sys.ext_help: Enable/disable, start or stop. Changes go to the engine immediately. Strategy plugins are managed under Strategy.
sys.ext_empty: No non-strategy plugins reported — wait for a snapshot or check engine config.
sys.empty_offline: Engine offline — connect the bridge to edit settings.
ai.keys_hint: Create multiple provider profiles below. API key is per profile (******** = keep existing). Market keys: Window → API keys…
ai.cursor_hint: Cursor: pip install cursor-sdk · paste key here or set CURSOR_API_KEY
ai.empty_profiles_hint: No profiles yet. Press + to create one.
ai.profile_id_invalid: invalid profile id — use a-z / 0-9 / _, start with a letter
ai.hint_offline: No snapshot — connect engine to edit AI.
ai.drawer.title: Ask AI
ai.drawer.empty1: Ask about runtime, universe, strategies, or risk.
ai.drawer.offline: Engine offline — connect bridge to ask.
ai.drawer.not_ready: AI not ready — configure providers in System · AI.
ai.drawer.no_key_hint: No API key for this profile — System → AI → paste key → Apply (persists to sqlite).
keys.title: API keys
keys.intro: Keys for market APIs. Leave blank to keep existing. Apply stores them in SQLite operator_secrets (not in YAML).
keys.bitget_help: API key + secret + passphrase (BITGET_PASSWORD). Public candles work without keys; keys help for private endpoints / higher limits. Paper mode still simulates fills.
keys.alpaca_help: Not required for Bitget/CCXT. Paper keys if you enable alpaca_market_service.
keys.alpaca_env: Alpaca also reads process env if fields empty.
keys.persist_hint: Saved to data/storage SQLite. Restart Engine if the market adapter started before keys were set.
panel.hint_nobars: no bars — pick symbol / wait ticks
strat.title: Strategy — {id}
strat.no_metrics: No live metrics yet — wait for candles / signals.
strat.no_params: No parameters in config for this strategy.
strat.viz_yes: This strategy has chart visuals (preview below). Pin them onto the main Desk/Charts graph.
strat.viz_no: No built-in chart recipe for this strategy yet — metrics only.
members.click_hint: Click a strategy name for details and chart overlays.
strat.page_subtitle: Full roster, Consilium membership, details and chart
strat.page_howto: Left: mode per strategy — Consilium / observe / off. Observe keeps running and logs signals but does not vote or trade. Apply lineup saves.
strat.page_empty: Select a strategy on the left to see details and chart.
strat.roster_help: Three modes: Consilium (votes), observe (signals for audit/phantom, no execution), off (silent). Apply lineup saves and starts/stops plugins.
strat.roster_hint: Click the name to open the dossier on the right.
strat.desc.ma_cross.2: Compares a fast SMA ({fast} bars) to a slow SMA ({slow} bars).
strat.desc.ma_cross.3: BUY when fast is above slow · SELL when fast is below slow.
strat.desc.ma_cross.4: Lines on the chart = the same averages the strategy uses.
strat.desc.mr.2: Looks at a rolling mean over {window} bars.
strat.desc.mr.3: Trades when price wanders ~{z} standard deviations away.
strat.desc.mr.4: Chart shows the mean and ±threshold bands when available.
strat.desc.test: Demo / test strategy — emits sample signals for Operator plumbing.
strat.desc.generic: Strategy vote member. Metrics below come from its last operator view.
strat.settings_help: Change class, tickers and knobs, then Apply. Same values as on Consilium.
desk.positions.hint.paper: Paper positions from consilium — simulated, no exchange account needed
desk.positions.hint.live: Account / protection positions in the selected mode
chart.hover.candle: Candle {time}  O {o}  H {h}  L {l}  C {c}  V {v}
web.desk.desc: Runtime posture, book, votes and tape
tip.nav.desk: Live trading desk: chart, positions, votes, kill/resume.
tip.nav.charts: Full OHLC + equity charts for any active symbol.
tip.nav.book: Choose which instruments are active (universe / book).
tip.nav.system: Market feeds, API keys, risk limits, AI, storage.
tip.shell.status: Quick engine link, trading state, mode and equity.
tip.shell.link: WebSocket / bridge connection to the engine.
tip.desk.kill: Pause new entries (KILL). Does not flatten positions.
tip.desk.resume: Allow new entries again after pause.
tip.desk.close_all: Flatten all open positions (paper or live with confirm).
tip.desk.reset_paper: Clear the simulated paper book (paper mode only).
tip.desk.save_config: Write current engine config to YAML on disk.
tip.desk.stats: High-level trading posture from the last snapshot.
tip.desk.state: TRADING = entries allowed. PAUSED = kill switch active.
tip.desk.mode: paper = simulated fills; live/quik = real venue.
tip.desk.equity: Marked portfolio equity from the runtime book.
tip.desk.fills: Fill count in the current session / ledger.
tip.desk.chart: Live candles for the selected book symbol (same feed as Charts).
tip.desk.chart_symbol: Pick which active instrument to plot.
tip.desk.risk: Risk caps and whether Consilium autotrade is enabled.
tip.desk.positions: Open positions from the runtime book.
tip.desk.votes: Latest Consilium member stances and weights.
tip.book.apply: Apply the selected list to the engine. Internally this is SET_UNIVERSE — it updates the active trading book and persists to config.
tip.book.mode: How the engine builds the active list.
tip.book.mode_select: manual = only checked keys. screener = ranked by profile. hybrid = both.
tip.book.profile: Optional screener profile name from universe config.
tip.book.add_key: Add a CLASS:SYMBOL key that is not in the catalog yet.
tip.book.catalog: Catalog from market services. Checked items become the active book when you Apply.
tip.book.toggle: Include or exclude this instrument from the active book.
